choice.basis: The dashboard 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)' shows the bar for Product C is the shortest, with its top edge located between the 20,000 and 30,000 tick marks. Visually, the bar height is clearly below the 25,000 midpoint (halfway between 20k and 30k). According to the provided policy table, a unit count of '< 25,000 units' activates the 'Low-demand review queue'. While the value is also within 2,500 units of the threshold (approx. 24,000), the low-demand review is the primary, unambiguous route supported by the visual evidence of the bar being below the 25,000 mark.
